Observed: the billing-db-proxy DBProxy (ack-system) closes idle client connections after 600 s (spec.idleClientTimeout), while billing-api recycles idle pool connections after 900 s (DB_POOL_IDLE_TIMEOUT_SECONDS). 504s rose on billing-api with the pod Running and Ready, no restart. The deployment log records the change setting idleClientTimeout to 600 on the billing DBProxy about 12 h ago.
Root cause: the proxy's idle timeout (600 s) is shorter than the pool's recycling (900 s), so the pool reuses connections the proxy already closed (RB-014).
Action: the platform team raises the DBProxy idleClientTimeout above 900 s, or the billing team lowers the pool's idle timeout below 600 s.
Ruled out: memory growth, a symptom of failing requests, not the cause (RB-007's warning); the load balancer idle timeout change, which concerns long exports only.
